headline: VN.ai, a startup, says Midjourney's image generator copied protected Hollywood characters more often than any of the 15 AI models it tested.
score_reason: Kept at pool score: one startup's test results, relevant to ongoing studio lawsuits.
importance_line: Studios suing AI firms get fresh figures on how often models copy protected characters, but the numbers come from one company's tests and Midjourney has not responded.
summary: Deadline reports that VN.ai, a startup that stress-tests AI tools for copyright infringement, found that Midjourney v8.1 reproduced copyrighted characters more often than any other model and put them in harmful contexts in 37% of prompts, also the highest. Every one of the 15 models tested produced at least one protected character; Midjourney did not comment, and it faces suits from Disney, NBCUniversal and Warner Bros Discovery and argues that training on copyrighted images is fair use.
notes: Exclusive to Deadline; based on one company's test.
